The cascode makes gain about gm1*ro_p (about 55 dB); L_p=1.5 keeps the gain low enough that f3db stays above 66 kHz. gm1 is about 190 uS, giving GBW near 45 MHz. Budget: 10 uA IREF + 19 uA tail + 1 uA divider, about 54 uW. Swing is roughly 0.6-1.6 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "W1":   (10.0, 4.0, 30.0),    # input pair W [um] (weak inversion, gm/Id~20)
    "L1":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Wc":   (6.0, 2.0, 20.0),     # NMOS cascode W
    "Lc":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Wp":   (8.0, 3.0, 25.0),     # PMOS mirror W
    "Lp":   (1.5, 1.0, 2.5),      # sets ro_p -> gain (and f3db upper limit)
    "Wt":   (6.0, 2.0, 15.0),     # tail/reference unit W
    "Lt":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "mt":   (2, 1, 3),            # tail = mt * IREF
    "vcas": (1.2, 1.05, 1.35),    # cascode gate bias from divider
    "Rdiv": (1.8e6, 0.9e6, 4e6),  # total divider resistance
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    mt = int(round(p["mt"]))
    itail = mt * iref
    i1 = itail / 2

    # Divider: vdd -> vcas -> vref(=vin_dc) -> vss
    Rt = p["Rdiv"]
    vcas = p["vcas"]
    R3 = Rt * vin / vdd
    R2 = Rt * (vcas - vin) / vdd
    R1 = Rt - R2 - R3
    idiv = vdd / Rt

    # Solve input-device Vgs for i1 (bisection with forward model)
    def solve_vgs(dev, W, L, I, vds, vsb=0.0):
        lo, hi = 0.2, 1.5
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] > I:
                hi = mid
            else:
                lo = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    vgs1 = solve_vgs('n', p["W1"], p["L1"], i1, 0.25, 0.2)
    vs = vin - vgs1
    vgsc = solve_vgs('n', p["Wc"], p["Lc"], i1, 0.3, 0.45)
    vx = vcas - vgsc
    vsgp = solve_vgs('p', p["Wp"], p["Lp"], i1, 1.0)
    vout = vdd - vsgp

    o1 = lut.op('n', p["W1"], p["L1"], vgs1, max(vx - vs, 0.05), max(vs, 0.0))
    oc = lut.op('n', p["Wc"], p["Lc"], vgsc, max(vout - vx, 0.05), max(vx, 0.0))
    op_ = lut.op('p', p["Wp"], p["Lp"], vsgp, vsgp)

    gm1 = o1["gm"]
    rout_n = (oc["gm"] / oc["gds"]) / o1["gds"]
    gout = op_["gds"] + 1.0 / rout_n
    A = gm1 / gout
    cpar = 2e-15 * (p["Wp"] + p["Wc"]) + 30e-15
    ctot = cl + cpar
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    f3db = gbw / A
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + idiv)
    vmin = vx + 0.12
    vmax = vdd - 0.15
    swing = vmax - vmin

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: reference diode + tail mirror
    n.M("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wt"], p["Lt"])
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wt"] * mt, p["Lt"], m=mt)
    # divider
    n.R("R1", "vdd", "vcas", R1)
    n.R("R2", "vcas", "vref", R2)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    # input pair (vin -> non-inverting path to vout)
    n.M("M1", "x1", "vref", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W1"], p["L1"])
    n.M("M2", "x2", "vin", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W1"], p["L1"])
    # NMOS cascodes
    n.M("M3", "d1", "vcas", "x1", "vss", "nfet", p["Wc"], p["Lc"])
    n.M("M4", "vout", "vcas", "x2", "vss", "nfet", p["Wc"], p["Lc"])
    # PMOS mirror load (diode on reference side)
    n.M("M5", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp"], p["Lp"])
    n.M("M6", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp"], p["Lp"])

    return n, {"gain_db": 20 * math.log10(max(A, 1e-3)), "gbw": gbw, "f3db": f3db,
               "power": power, "vout_dc": vout, "swing": swing}
